title: 3.0 - BelongsToMany saving complex relations

milestone.description:
New major release that breaks compatibility with 2.x

- PHP5.4.19+
- New ORM & behaviors.
- Improved Routing
- PSR-0 and composer support.
- Simpler configuration and bootstrapping.
- Improved configuration handling.
- Improved bake.

See [the roadmap](http://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/wiki/3.0-roadmap) for more details.

body:
Offers hasMany Estates through OffersObjects
Estates belongsTo Address

when trying to save Offers with sample data

``` php
$data=[
 "id"=>2,
 'estates'=>[
    0=>[
      '_joinData'=>['table'=>'Estates']
      'address'=>['street'=>'XXXX']
    ]
  ]
];
```

I get the error:
Cannot save Addresses, it is not associated to OffersObjects

It seems when it saves OffersObjects link (_saveLinks) it gets passed 'associated' key from its target (passed in save in controller) in $options which forces CakePHP to save direct relation between Addresses and OffersObjects which doesnt exist.
